name: Proximity: covered skin 2-10 mm from the metal while following
No part enters the body, any frame of any clip
Follows the arm (frames tracked, not held at a limit)
At most 4 DOF, counted kinematically (target 3; a torque-free passive self-aligning joint is the one exception)
No interference between parts that move relative to each other
Every custom part is one valid closed solid

name: Strength: SF >= 1.5 at 25 N.m worst direction; deflection and fatigue bounded

name: Base on a thorax back plate: worst GH misalignment (proposed: half the 2-10 mm band)

name: Interface pressure under ISO/TS 15066 body-region limits
